title: Government of India in consultation with Government of Arunachal Pradesh identified 27 places/features located in Arunachal Pradesh by standard place and feature names on the official maps of Survey of India
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Home Affairs

Government of India in consultation with Government of Arunachal Pradesh identified 27 places/features located in Arunachal Pradesh by standard place and feature names on the official maps of Survey of India

Identifying them formally on Survey of India map of Arunachal Pradesh is aimed at facilitating their accurate recognition and better awareness among the public at large

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
07 AUG 2026 5:35PM by PIB Delhi

The Government of India, in consultation with State Government of Arunachal Pradesh, has identified a total of twenty-seven (27) places/features located in Arunachal Pradesh, by standard place and feature names on the official maps of Survey of India (SoI). Identifying them formally on the Survey of India map of Arunachal Pradesh is aimed at facilitating their accurate recognition and better awareness among the public at large.

These twenty-seven (27) places/features so identified on the Survey of India map of the State of Arunachal Pradesh, are as under:
